title: path.resolve, contract version 1
description: Resolves a URL to the placement it shows (PRD 5.9): the host the request names, which the configuration maps to a site, the locale and the path. path.resolve is a public query, which every principal may read. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Routing\Domain\Queries\ResolvePath, and the generated codec ResolvePathCodecV1 reads it and writes its canonical JSON: every key, sorted, no whitespace. Its result is path.resolve.result.v1.json.

host.description: The host of the URL: a DNS name with an optional port, written back in lowercase.

locale.description: The locale, a language tag such as da, en-GB or sr-Latn-RS, written back with the language in lowercase, the script in title case and the region in uppercase.

path.description: The path of the URL, which starts with a slash: / or segments of no slash and no white space, at most 32 segments and 2048 bytes, without . or .. segments.
